Requires account authentication and valid membership (ownership or saved shared access). Validates membership permissions, expiration, and issuer authority before issuing. Running browsers stream live video; paused browsers display the last authorized frame without auto-resuming. The ticket is passed to the isolated viewer origin via secure handshake—never exposing account cookies or API keys. Shared access grants view-only permissions; lifecycle, deletion, fork, reshare, and CDP operations are not permitted. Returns the viewer ticket for use in the viewer origin.
